messages:
Nina Gupta: Noticed a gap in telemetry aggregates for `user_actions` 2026-03-21 00:00-04:00 UTC on the hourly dashboard. Looks like late partition arrivals from `ingest-psi`.
Omar Reyes: I see the same. Hourly agg shows zeros for tenant_ids 9001-9006. Any idea if upstream dedupe changed?
Marta Ivanova: Upstream deployed a fix yesterday that slightly changed the event key. We should avoid full replay until we verify idempotency.
Kai Wong: Suggestion: use the console's targeted backfill with `preview` mode that emits a sample diff + estimated compute units. We need a UX improvement: show routing/quota labels in the preview so teams know cost tier.
Nina Gupta: Agreed. Current preview just shows counts. For safety: run a 1-hour slice dry-run with partition subset, diff and checksum, then evaluate cache invalidation surface.
Omar Reyes: I'll spin a job: POST /internal/reprocess with body `{range:"2026-03-21T01:00:00Z/2026-03-21T02:00:00Z",tenants:[9002,9003],preview:true,emit_samples:10,quota:"background"}`. Will tag it with `route_policy:fair-share`.
backfill-bot: Job created: preview-job-1718401111-0902 (status: queued)
Marta Ivanova: Reminder: KV cache TTL is 12h for these keys. If we promote the run we must emit invalidation stamps `inv:user_actions:tenant:9002:20260321T01`. Add to runbook.
Kai Wong: UX ask: add an `invalidate_on_promote` checkbox in console so ops can preview invalidation keys and choose to apply them automatically on promote. Also surface potential downstream recompute cost estimate.
Nina Gupta: Good call. Ops should also be able to pick `quota_profile` (low/medium/high) and see expected wait time based on current fair-share queue depth.
Omar Reyes: Preview job started. Including sample rows and checksums to S3 at s3://telemetry-previews/1718401111/preview.jsonl.gz
backfill-bot: Job running: preview-job-1718401111-0902 (status: running)
Kai Wong: When the preview finishes, console should show: top 3 sample diffs, checksum delta %, estimated CU, route label, and suggested next action (promote | schedule | abort). Small modal, inline.
Marta Ivanova: Also: if checksum delta > 0.5% escalate to data-platform and hold promotion. We should codify that as a temporary rule for this incident.
Nina Gupta: Agree. Set an alert on the promote endpoint to require an `approval` tag for deltas > 0.5%.
Omar Reyes: Preview results uploaded. Checksum delta: 0.03%. Sample diff: 3 rows changed, small schema-normalization differences.
backfill-bot: Job finished: preview-job-1718401111-0902 (status: success)
Kai Wong: Looks safe. I'm going to add the UI patch to show `quota_profile` + est wait time. Will open PR and flag for quick review.
Marta Ivanova: I can prepare the promote run: range same as preview, partitions expanded to 9001-9006, quota_profile: medium, schedule window: 02:00-05:00 UTC (off-peak). Also will include `invalidate_on_promote=true`.
Nina Gupta: Before promote, run a quick smoke on downstream dashboards (a sample dashboard job) to ensure no regression.
Omar Reyes: Curl for promote (internal): ```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-api/reprocess -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"range":"2026-03-21T00:00:00Z/2026-03-21T04:00:00Z","tenants":[9001,9002,9003,9004,9005,9006],"preview":false,"quota_profile":"medium","schedule":"2026-03-21T02:00:00Z","invalidate_on_promote":true}'
```
backfill-bot: Promote run queued: promote-1718401877-9001 (status: queued)
Kai Wong: Great. Let's track in the incident board and post final summary here when complete. :rocket:
